definition: Spinocerebellar ataxia 52 (SCA52; OMIM #621535) is an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder associated with pathogenic variants in the RAB3A gene, clinically characterized by core manifestations of gait and limb ataxia, nystagmus, and cerebellar atrophy, along with variable dysarthria, dysphagia, and urinary urgency. Detailed cohort-specific numerators, discriminative phenotype analyses, absent findings, genotype-phenotype correlations, and contradicting reports are not comprehensively provided in the available source context.
